task.title: Viewing Search Terms in the Corpus
task.shortdesc: You can use the Concordance Plot tool view individual search terms within a map of search terms.

context.p: To view search terms within a corpus:

step.cmd: Use the Concordance Plot tool to map search terms within a corpus.
Use the Plot Zoom arrows to zoom in or out of the map if desired.
Click on one vertical KWIC line within the map to display a highlighted instance of the term within the File View tool.
Command + Click on one vertical KWIC line within the map to display a highlighted instance of the term within the File View tool.
Click the Clone Results button in the File View window to save the results in a new window.
